Raspberry Pi 5 Gehäuse + Lüfter + NVMe (Geekworm X1001)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/746241-raspberry-pi-5-case-fan-nvme-geekworm-x1001?from=search#profileId-1605496

Case for raspberry pi 5
- with cooling fan kit
- with NVMe kit Geekworm X1001
 

Use the screws from the NVMe kit to fix the raspberry pi on the base
The top is mechanically fixed by a simple pressure. Very simple to open.

Update 2025-06-18: 
- added print profile with 8 variants
- better microSD access
- new poweroff button

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: new model
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF), PLA (#000000), PLA (#C12E1E), PLA (#19C344)
